Last week, I adopted my dog from this shelter and had him neutered here.

A few days later, the surgical site became inflamed. I took him to a veterinary hospital near my home, but I was quoted around $2,000 for treatment. Unfortunately, I simply couldn’t afford that, so I brought him back to the clinic where the surgery was originally performed.

Although appointments are required, scheduling one over the phone was quick and easy. I didn’t have to wait long, and the staff helped me get everything arranged smoothly.

I’m about to leave my dog in their care again, and I’m hoping everything goes well. Thank you in advance for taking care of him. 🙏

Kat is amazing. She’s so knowledgeable, helpful, and most of all kind. We had a lot of questions and she helped us out so well. Took our foster kittens to their mobile clinic to get their 1st round of shots. We don’t have an appointment but they have walk up available from certain timeframes. It was a great experience.

They already know my name I've brought so many of our cats. Yes I have many cats more  than 15. I have brought them all here. They give shots microchip nail triming and I think flea treatment for the exaggerated price of $0.00.  and they don't require blood work or shots like other places do. Or a fee of so and so like other places. They ask for pet parents to get a voucher from the city to get free services or at a discount but if you have many pets like I do you don't qualify for it. They have a max of 3 per family per household or address. But as long as you register by 6am for your an appointment they will help you without a voucher. Honestly this organization is the best. they do care about reducing the overpopulation of cats and dogs. I highly recommend their services.

The ASPCA really does help kittens...they operated on more than 20 stray kittens near my apartment and didn't ask me for anything.

Brought my five month old puppy here to get microchipped. I was trying to make an appointment online, but was not able to. It clearly says on their website that an appointment is not necessary. However, they wouldn’t see me without an appointment. The woman outside checking people in was very rude. She said that without my puppy being seen, they wouldn’t even see him. I mentioned he was five months old and his vet won’t fix him until he’s at least 6 or 7 months old. She brushed me off and said that the would chip him if I decided to get him fixed right there and then. It almost felt like a requirement or money grab from them. I called multiple places to verify if this is a requirement and no other place agreed. I would highly highly recommend looking elsewhere. Petsmart was great, efficient and friendly. This woman looked as if she didn’t even want to be there

He then told me they had to " cancel " my cats appointment and when I further questioned him,  he sent me a letter of " Termination of Services "Which begs the question was this am unnecessary procedure that they used my cat as a guinea pig for his students. Had my fur baby spayed here. The process was very fast. You have to go online at 6 am to be put on waitlist for that day. Check in time starts at 7am. During check in the staff let you know what to expect during the surgery and aftercare instructions and how pick up works. Pick up is at 2:30 you have to go inside write yiur name down amd the staff will bring out your pet with after care instructions. The staff that I encountered were nice!

There was a waiting list that I had to go through, but it turned out to be completely fine.
